subject: general
question:
Which of the following observable changes indicate that a chemical reaction has occurred?

(a) Formation of gas

(b) Formation of precipitates

(c) Change in physical state

(d) Colour change
solution:
The correct answer is __**(a), (b), (c) and (d)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Formation of gas:** The release of gas bubbles during a reaction indicates the occurrence of a chemical reaction.
 
• **Formation of precipitates:** The appearance of a solid substance in a solution shows that a chemical reaction has taken place.
 
• **Change in physical state:** The transition of substances from one state (solid, liquid, gas) to another is a clear sign of a chemical reaction.
 
• **Colour change:** A change in color during a reaction suggests the formation of new substances with different properties.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Reactants and Products:** In a chemical reaction, the substances that react are called reactants, and the new substances formed are called products.
 
• **Exothermic and Endothermic Reactions:** Exothermic reactions release energy in the form of heat, while endothermic reactions absorb energy from the surroundings.
 
• **Catalysts:** Catalysts are substances that increase the rate of a chemical reaction without being consumed in the process.
 
• **Conservation of Mass:** The law of conservation of mass states that mass is neither created nor destroyed in a chemical reaction; it is conserved.
 
• **Types of Chemical Reactions:** Common types include synthesis, decomposition, single displacement, and double displacement reactions.
